text: najīratisuttaṃ [209] kiṃsu 1 jīrati kiṃ na jīrati kiṃsu uppathoti vuccati kiṃsu dhammānaṃ paripantho kiṃsu rattindivakkhayo kiṃ malaṃ brahmacariyassa kiṃ sinānamanodakaṃ kati lokasmi chiddāni yattha cittaṃ na tiṭṭhati bhagavantaṃ 2 puṭṭhumāgamma kathaṃ jānemu taṃ mayanti . [210] rūpaṃ jīrati maccānaṃ nāmagottaṃ na jīrati ............... rāgo uppathoti vuccati lobho dhammānaṃ paripantho vayo rattindivakkhayo itthī malaṃ brahmacariyassa etthāyaṃ sajjate pajā tapo ca brahmacariyañca taṃ sinānamanodakaṃ cha lokasmi chiddāni yattha cittaṃ 3 na tiṭṭhati ālasyañca pamādo ca anuṭṭhānamasaṃyamo niddā tandī ca te chidde sabbaso taṃ vivajjayeti . #1 po. ma. yu. kiṃ . 2 po. yu. bhavantaṃ . 3 ma. vittaṃ . sattamaṃ
